authorization: 用户明确要求：每篇固定三名新的 subagent，只处理当前这一篇。当前篇通过审计并记录完成后，三人退出，下一篇换三名新 subagent；三人继续第二遍检查和疑点恢复，并在最新快照上完成三轮独立终审。
independence_scope: Three distinct actual agents independently inspect the current note. They continue across phases within the same note, as explicitly required for this campaign; they are not represented as previously uninvolved fresh reviewers at the final phase.
